name: plugin.skill_knowledge_graph
description: Knowledge graph indexer, semantic router, and visual topology generator for agent skill cards
author: Brain Harness Forge Engine

entrypoints.name: select_skills_for_task
entrypoints.description: Select skills and compile a prerequisite-aware execution plan for an agent task using the skill knowledge graph

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Natural language task or intent prompt

parameters.name: max_skills
parameters.description: Maximum number of skills to select (default: 5)

parameters.name: include_verifier
parameters.description: Whether to append a quality/adversarial verifier skill (default: true)

entrypoints.name: cluster_skill_graph
entrypoints.description: Cluster workspace skills into functional capability domains and discover novel capabilities

parameters.name: min_cluster_size
parameters.description: Minimum skill count for a cluster (default: 2)

entrypoints.name: discover_emergent_capabilities
entrypoints.description: Search for emergent macro-capabilities formed by composite multi-skill pipelines

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional search filter for capability domain

entrypoints.name: get_cross_cluster_bridges
entrypoints.description: Discover cross-domain macro-bridges connecting distinct clusters

entrypoints.name: index_skill_catalog
entrypoints.description: Scan workspace (.agents/skills and plugin directories) to build the in-memory skill knowledge graph

entrypoints.name: query_skill_router
entrypoints.description: Find the optimal skill or multi-skill execution chain for a given task description or intent

parameters.name: intent
parameters.description: Natural language task or intent prompt

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Number of top matching skills to return (default: 3)

entrypoints.name: find_skill_chain
entrypoints.description: Compute the shortest directed path or multi-skill pipeline from a start skill to a target objective

entrypoints.name: get_skill_topology
entrypoints.description: Retrieve upstream prerequisites, downstream handoffs, invariants, and mitigated anti-patterns for a given skill

parameters.name: skill_name
parameters.description: Name of the skill to inspect

entrypoints.name: export_skill_graph_visual
entrypoints.description: Generate an interactive visual HTML brief in %TEMP% rendering the Mermaid DAG of all skills and category clusters
